.PHONY: all test clean
CC ?= cc
CFLAGS := -O2 -Wall $(if $(DEBUG),-g,)
SRC = $(wildcard *.c)
OBJ = $(SRC:.c=.o)

all: app

app: $(OBJ)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

test: app
	@./app && echo ok || (echo fail; exit 1)

define multi
	echo one
	echo two
endef

clean: ; rm -f $(OBJ) app
-include deps.mk
ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
EXT = .exe
else
EXT =
endif
